items.label: Multiple Tiers Storage
items.value: An open tabletop, four drawers, and a two-tier cabinet make multiple tiers for meeting your different storage needs, organizing your everyday household products well, and keeping your odds and ends in order

items.label: Safe to Use
items.value: Come with anti-tipping devices to improve safety. Equipped with a built-in come-off preventing unit is provided to prevent the drawer from accidentally sliding out. Each door panel of the small drawer has a slight concave opening for easy pulling out and added aesthetic quality

items.label: Easy Opening / Closing
items.value: The cabinet door is equipped with a magnetic device for easy opening and closing. The accompanying hinges are durable, and the door panel has a round knob. Also, each drawer has a slight concave space on the front panel for easy handling and beauty

items.label: Easy Setup
items.value: This freestanding bathroom storage cabinet comes with easy-to-read instructions and anti-toppling fittings. Fix the cabinet with the fittings before use.

items.label: Space Saving
items.value: Four drawers with cutout handles and one cupboard with a customizable shelf for you to organize different items like cosmetics, toiletries, towels, toilet paper, etc. An excellent option for tucking away clutter

items.label: Room Type
items.value: Bathroom, Entryway, Hallway, Home Office, Living Room
